get.description:
Each SSE message has the event name from `DocumentEvent` (for example `created`)
and a JSON `DocumentEvent` as data. Each event is followed by an unnamed message holding the
Turbo Streams that update the web UI. Comment-only keep-alive frames are sent every 30 seconds.

CreateCorrespondentRequest.description: Request body for creating a correspondent

CreateDocumentRequest.description: Request body for creating a document

CreateDocumentTypeRequest.description: Request body for creating a document type

CreateTagRequest.description: Request body for creating a tag

content.description: Extracted text content (from OCR or text extraction)

created_at.description: When the document was created in the system

file_path.description: Path to the stored file (relative to storage root)

mime_type.description: MIME type of the original document

page_count.description: Number of pages in the document (for PDFs and multi-page images)

updated_at.description: When the document was last updated

DocumentEvent.description: Event types that can be broadcast to clients

DocumentSource.description: The source of a document, with kind-specific metadata

source_name.description: Name of the ingestion source that produced the document, if any

DocumentType.description: A document type for classification (e.g., Invoice, Receipt, Contract)

created_at.description: When the document type was created

allowed_content_types.description: Attachment content types to import; `image/*` style wildcards are allowed

password.description: Shown as `********` by the API; send it back unchanged to keep the stored one

password_file.description: Read the password from this file (for Docker secrets); wins over `password`

EmailOrigin.description: The email an attachment (or the message itself) came from

account.description: Name of the configured mail account

FileContent.description: Binary payload of a stored file

FolderAfterImport.description: What to do with a consume-folder file once it was imported

rescan_secs.description: Full scan interval; the file watcher usually reacts sooner

settle_secs.description: How long a file's size has to stay unchanged before it is imported

subfolders_as_tags.description: Turn sub-folder names into tags: `Insurance/2025/x.pdf` gets `Insurance` and `2025`

FolderOrigin.description: Where in a consume folder a file was found

relative_path.description: Path relative to the consume folder, using `/` separators

IngestionSourceInput.description: Fields for creating or replacing a managed source

MailAfterImport.description: What to do with a mail once its attachments were imported

MailBody.description: Whether the mail itself becomes a document

MailSecurity.description: How to reach the mail server

NamedRef.description: A related entity, by id and display name

ProcessingStatus.description: State of one pipeline stage for one document

RunStatus.description: Where a run is in its lifecycle

SourceConditions.description: Conditions on where a document came from; every set condition has to match

email_attachment_glob.description: Glob against the attachment file name

email_mailbox_glob.description: Glob against the mailbox name, for example `INBOX/Invoices`

folder_path_glob.description: Glob against the folder-relative path, for example `Insurance/*`

SourceOrigin.description: Where a source definition came from

SourceStatus.description: How the latest run of a source went

last_error.description: Set when the latest run failed; cleared by the next success

message.description: What was found, or why the check failed

SourceView.description: A source with its latest run

origin.description: Sources from the server configuration are read-only

color.description: Optional color for UI display (hex format, e.g., "#ff5733")

TestDelivery.description: Outcome of sending the sample payload to one webhook

status.description: HTTP status of the response, when one arrived

success.description: The receiver answered with a 2xx status

deliveries.description: One entry per webhook action, in order

oneOf.description: `*` and `?` wildcards, case-insensitive, against the whole text

glob.description: `*` and `?` wildcards, case-insensitive, against the whole text

oneOf.description: Regular expression, searched anywhere in the text

regex.description: Regular expression, searched anywhere in the text

TextMatch.description: How to compare a piece of text

UpdateCorrespondentRequest.description: Request body for updating a correspondent

UpdateDocumentTypeRequest.description: Request body for updating a document type

UpdateTagRequest.description: Request body for updating a tag

color.description: Omit to keep the current color; send `null` to clear it

UploadDocumentRequest.description: Multipart form accepted by the upload endpoint

file.description: The file to store and run through OCR

title.description: Document title; defaults to the file name

WebhookDocument.description: The document an event is about, as it was when the event happened

asn.description: Archive serial number; always null until Folio supports serial numbers

size.description: File size in bytes; null when no file is stored

source.description: How the document entered Folio, with folder or email details when known

WebhookMethod.description: HTTP method used for webhook delivery

WebhookUrls.description: Links to the document, absolute so receivers can follow them

oneOf.description: Send the event payload to an HTTP endpoint

headers.description: Extra request headers; `X-Folio-*` headers cannot be overridden

secret.description: Shared secret used to sign deliveries; unsigned when absent

oneOf.description: Discard the file instead of importing it; only valid for `ingest.received`

WorkflowAction.description: A step a workflow performs, in order

WorkflowConditions.description: Conditions a document must meet; every set condition has to match

document_type_id.description: The document has this document type

filename_glob.description: Glob (`*` and `?`) matched case-insensitively against the original filename

mime_type.description: MIME type, exact or with a wildcard subtype such as `image/*`

source.description: Where the document came from: folder path, email sender, subject, and so on

WorkflowInput.description: Fields for creating or replacing a workflow

WorkflowRun.description: One execution of a workflow for one event

completed_actions.description: How many actions already finished, so a retry resumes where it stopped

document_id.description: Not a foreign key: runs outlive the documents they were about

id.description: Also sent as `X-Folio-Delivery`, so receivers can de-duplicate retries

response_status.description: HTTP status of the latest webhook response

WorkflowTrigger.description: Events a workflow can listen for
